profile_text.body:
GitHub, owned by Microsoft, describes itself as the world's most widely adopted AI-powered developer platform, used by millions of developers, businesses, and what it calls the largest open source community. The site positions GitHub as a place where software is built across the full development lifecycle, from a first line of code through to final deployment, with AI and automation tools intended to help users build and ship software faster.

GitHub's principal AI product is GitHub Copilot, categorized as a coding and developer tool that provides code completion functionality. The product has been associated with questions around source-code exposure, noted in the site's own product records.
